claycode.delta: Implement control-flow closure in canonical typed IR: conditional branch, recursive call with resource bound, Result-like structured failure/match, transitive effect fixed-point summaries and diagnostics. Keep runtime EffectPermit separate from effect summaries. Do not freeze new surface syntax from this proxy.

frank.delta: FRANK loop-of-loops requires reusable bounded control semantics, but no FRANK-specific recursion/effect primitive is justified. Re-entry/control lineage may carry semantic dependency identity; external effect authority must be freshly validated.

clayresearch.delta: BASE-first path strengthened: close control/effect semantics and external authority before architecture expansion. Proxy is mechanism support only.

claygraph.delta: Activation/association must not resolve function/effect authority. Graph may store dependency/effect ancestry but exact typed compiler identity decides closure.

unifieddb.delta: Persist program semantic identity separately from permit/execution-attempt identity; physical store choice remains open and no merge is implied.

gwt.delta: R7 admission/continuation and re-entry semantics fit the candidate: recurrence may preserve decision/dependency identity but authority_carried_forward remains false; effect execution requires fresh permit.

hyperposition.delta: Alternative control/effect candidates may coexist in research, but compiled/runtime effect authorization is a single explicit typed decision, not set-valued fuzzy authority.

emergenz.delta: Control-flow universality, recursion and effect closure remain implementation evidence, not emergence evidence.

harness.delta: Add Golden compiler/oracle fixtures for transitive effect omission, runtime permit absence/revocation, recursion budget, undefined calls, semantic-vs-attempt hash separation and idempotent replay across recurrence.

next_cross_branch_test: Integrate the smallest candidate into the production parser/canonical IR/type-effect checker, then lower the same corpus on the Ubuntu target and run capability revoke/regrant plus FFI/subprocess escape fixtures.
